snippet.title: Blood Covenant | Full Game Official Trailer | Co-op Anomaly Horror Cleaning Game
snippet.description:
Blood Covenant is a 1–4 player co-op anomaly horror job-sim where your hazmat crew cleans up crime scenes on the night shift while the building quietly changes things behind your back. Wishlist it on Steam and play the free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4818530/

Full game on Steam January 5, 2027.

Chapters
0:00 What the crew missed
0:11 Do the job and report the anomaly
0:23 The hunt
0:33 The ritual

You clock in at the van and take your directives from a dispatcher who knows far more than he says, and on paper the work is simple enough, mostly mopping blood and hammering the breaches in the walls shut. While you work, chairs turn to face the wall, cabinets slide across the room and figures appear in corners where nothing stood a minute ago. Every anomaly you report keeps your record clean, while every one you miss (and every false alarm) makes the ritual at the end of the night harder, because the creature that comes for you is built from the exact things your crew failed to see.

Play it solo or bring up to three friends in online co-op, with built-in voice chat and full controller support. The first contract is Hargrove Psychiatric Institute, and the jobs after it take you out to old farmhouses and deep into the woods.

Everything in this trailer is real in-game footage with the game's own sound.

Wishlist and free demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4818530/
Discord: https://discord.gg/7zuhmx9VQA
Dev updates newsletter: https://delajea-press.kit.com/22fee97cb2

Developed and published by DelaJea Press.
